name: Ilyushin Aviation Complex

what_it_is: Ilyushin Aviation Complex (part of Russia's UAC) designs the Il-76 strategic airlifter and its Il-78 tanker derivative. The IAF operates six Il-78MKI tankers that underpin its aerial-refuelling capability, and legacy Il-76 Gajaraj transports remain in the heavy-lift fleet.
india_angle: India's entire operational tanker capability rests on six Il-78MKIs, whose overhaul status has been a persistent readiness concern in public reporting; two attempts to buy new tankers have failed and the IAF has shifted preference toward new-build alternatives, with Israel reported as sole bidder in a 2025 $900M tanker tender.
intelligence_assessment: Ilyushin's India file is a readiness-dependency story: the ageing tanker fleet is documented by major outlets, while replacement decisions sit with pending Indian programmes. Any Il-78 overhaul contract would be a significant readiness signal; absence of one is itself the strategic finding.

faq.q: How many Il-78 tankers does India operate?
faq.a: Public reporting consistently cites six Il-78MKI tankers in IAF service.

faq.q: What is India doing to replace the Il-78?
faq.a: Two earlier tanker tenders failed; a new tender was reported in 2025 with Israel as sole bidder.
